name: CHARLOTTE
source:
"This strange flower,  my hazy memories, and this person.. Why can't I remember?"

Play as a girl named Charlotte, trying to figure out and piece together why she is here; With a limited memory, and a blurry connection between a relationship. Is this a dream, or a memory?

[Edited from [url=https://showen102.itch.io/charlotte]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“这奇异的花，我朦胧的记忆，还有这个人……为什么我记不起来了？”

扮演一个名叫夏洛特的女孩，试图找出并拼凑出她在这里的原因；由于记忆有限，一段关系之间的联系也很模糊。这是梦，还是记忆？

[编辑自[url=https://showen102.itch.io/charlotte]itch.io[/url]]
